# AGENTS.md: lessons from past bug fixes

<!-- provenance -->
> **Extracted fact** from the code at commit `1a80fc8`, produced by static analysis with no AI model. Safe to rely on.


> **For any AI assistant and for human reviewers.** This works with Claude, Copilot, Cursor, Codex, Gemini and local models. Point a tool at this file or paste it into a system prompt.

Each entry below is a bug this repository's own history says was fixed, filed under the source file it changed. The wording is taken from the fix commit, not interpreted. **Before you change a listed file, read its entries and do not bring the same problem back.** Cite the commit if you reuse a lesson.

How these were found: commits whose subject says fix, bugfix or hotfix are kept; dependency updates and typo, format and lint changes are not. A fix counts only for source files still in the repository, and a fix that touched more than 15 source files is treated as a sweep and left out. Test files are not listed as the place that went wrong.
